articles.summary: EAGLE, Idaho, April 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Pennant Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: PNTG), the parent company of the Pennant group of affiliated home health, hospice, home care and senior living companies, today announced the acquisition of the real estate and operations of Arbor Rose Senior Living,
articles.title: Pennant Acquires Arbor Rose Senior Living Community in Mesa, Arizona
